name: agent-watch
description: Watch your helpers work: each subagent's model, tokens and estimated cost, and a file tree that marks what was read and what was changed, by whom.

showProgressLine.title: Progress line above the prompt
showProgressLine.description: While helpers (subagents) exist, show one line above the prompt: how many are running, the estimated cost so far and how many files were changed.

toastWhenHelperFinishes.title: Toast when a helper finishes
toastWhenHelperFinishes.description: A short toast with the helper's name, estimated cost and the files it changed.

maxFiles.title: Files shown in the pane
maxFiles.description: The most recently active files listed in the /agents pane. Default 40.
